scripts.contracts:validate: pnpm contracts:build && pnpm contracts:python && pnpm exec tsx scripts/validate-contract-json-schema.ts && pnpm contracts:conformance && pnpm contracts:check
scripts.docker:build:api: docker build -f docker/api.Dockerfile -t octo/api:sha-local --build-arg VERSION=local --build-arg REVISION=local --build-arg CREATED=local .
scripts.docker:build:runtime-worker: docker build -f docker/runtime-worker.Dockerfile -t octo/runtime-worker:sha-local --build-arg VERSION=local --build-arg REVISION=local --build-arg CREATED=local .
scripts.docker:build:scheduler-worker: docker build -f docker/scheduler-worker.Dockerfile -t octo/scheduler-worker:sha-local --build-arg VERSION=local --build-arg REVISION=local --build-arg CREATED=local .
scripts.docker:build:migrate: docker build -f docker/migrate.Dockerfile -t octo/migrate:sha-local --build-arg VERSION=local --build-arg REVISION=local --build-arg CREATED=local .
scripts.docker:build:f1: pnpm docker:build:api && pnpm docker:build:runtime-worker && pnpm docker:build:scheduler-worker && pnpm docker:build:migrate
scripts.f1:workspace-type-gate: pnpm --filter @octo/events build && pnpm --filter @octo/database build && pnpm --filter @octo/api typecheck && pnpm build && pnpm typecheck
